actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_call_details.description: Retrieve details for a specific Bland AI call.
actions.list_calls.description: List recent Bland AI calls with optional filters.
actions.list_calls.props.limit.descripti: Maximum number of calls to return.
actions.send_call.description: Initiate an AI phone call to a recipient.
actions.send_call.props.firstSentence.de: Exact opening line the agent will say when the call is answered. Leave blank to let the agent decide.
actions.send_call.props.language.descrip: Language code for transcription and speech (e.g. "en", "es", "fr"). Defaults to "babel-en" (English with accent tolerance).
actions.send_call.props.maxDuration.desc: Maximum call length in minutes. The call ends automatically after this time. Defaults to 30.
actions.send_call.props.model.descriptio: "Base" is the standard model. "Turbo" is faster with lower latency, recommended for time-sensitive conversations.
actions.send_call.props.pathwayId.descri: UUID of a pre-built Pathway from your Bland AI dashboard. When provided, it overrides the Task field. Find it in the Pathways section of your dashboard.
actions.send_call.props.phoneNumber.desc: The number to call in E.164 format (e.g. +12223334444). Must include the country code.
actions.send_call.props.record.descripti: When enabled, the call is recorded. The recording URL is included in the post-call data.
actions.send_call.props.summaryPrompt.de: Custom instructions for how the post-call summary should be written (max 2000 characters). Leave blank to use the default summary format.
actions.send_call.props.task.description: Instructions for the AI agent — what it should say, ask, or accomplish during the call. Not required if using a Pathway ID.
actions.send_call.props.transferPhoneNum: E.164 phone number to transfer the call to if the AI decides a human is needed (e.g. +12223334444).
actions.send_call.props.voice.descriptio: The voice the AI agent will use. Choose from Bland AI preset voices optimised for phone quality.
When enabled, the AI waits for the recipient to speak first before responding. Useful when calling into IVR systems.
actions.send_call.props.webhook.descript: URL that receives a POST request with full call data (transcript, summary, recording URL) after the call ends.
auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to your [Bland AI dashboard](https://app.bland.ai)
2. Go to **Profile** (bottom-left menu) -> **Settings**
3. Click **API Keys** and copy your key
description: AI phone calling platform for outbound and conversational voice workflows.
